metadata.question: Was there an active fire present in Monte Pisano in Northern Italy between February 24, 2019 and February 26, 2019?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: - Use MODIS or VIIRS active fire products (MOD14A1, MYD14A1, or FIRMS) - Date range: 2019-02-24 to 2019-02-26 - Location: Monte Pisano, Northern Italy (approximately 43.7°N, 10.5°E) - MODIS Terra: MOD14A1 or FIRMS collection - VIIRS: FIRMS VIIRS 2. Masking strategy: - No cloud masking needed - we're looking FOR fires - Check for fire pixels with confidence levels - Use FireMask or fire detection bands 3. Logic: - If collection is empty → C1 - If fire pixels detected (count > 0) → A (Yes) - If no fire pixels detected but valid data exists → B (No) - If calculation fails → C3 ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // 1. Define geometry for Monte Pisano, Northern Italy const montePisano = ee.Geometry.Point([10.5, 43.7]).buffer(10000); // 10km buffer // 2. Define date range const startDate = '2019-02-24'; const endDate = '2019-02-27'; // Inclusive end console.log('Searching for active fires in Monte Pisano...'); console.log('Date Range: 2019-02-24 to 2019-02-26'); // 3. Try MODIS Thermal Anomalies/Fire collection let fireCollection = ee.ImageCollection('MODIS/006/MOD14A1') .filterDate(startDate, endDate) .filterBounds(montePisano); const collectionSize = fireCollection.size().getInfo(); console.log('MODIS MOD14A1 Images Found: ' + collectionSize); if (collectionSize === 0) { // Try MYD14A1 (Aqua satellite) fireCollection = ee.ImageCollection('MODIS/006/MYD14A1') .filterDate(startDate, endDate) .filterBounds(montePisano); const aquaSize = fireCollection.size().getInfo(); console.log('MODIS MYD14A1 Images Found: ' + aquaSize); if (aquaSize === 0) { console.log('No fire detection data available for this period.'); console.log('C1'); return; } } // 4. Check for fire detections using FireMask band const fireMask = fireCollection.select('FireMask').mosaic(); // FireMask values: 0-6 (no fire), 7-9 (fire with varying confidence) const firePixels = fireMask.gte(7); // 5. Count fire pixels const fireStats = firePixels.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.sum(), geometry: montePisano, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }); const fireCount = fireStats.get('FireMask').getInfo(); console.log('Fire Pixel Count: ' + fireCount); // 6. Check total pixels to ensure valid data const totalPixels = fireMask.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.count(), geometry: montePisano, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('FireMask').getInfo(); console.log('Total Valid Pixels: ' + totalPixels); if (totalPixels === 0) { console.log('No valid pixels after processing.'); console.log('C2'); return; } if (fireCount === null || fireCount === undefined) { console.log('Calculation failed - invalid result.'); console.log('C3'); return; } // 7. Determine answer if (fireCount > 0) { console.log('Active fire(s) detected!'); console.log('A'); } else { console.log('No active fires detected.'); console.log('B'); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
